# Environment test fixture

`royal_esplanade_2k.hdr.jpg` is the original Ultra HDR JPEG used to test decoding,
environment caching and lossless resource packaging independently of sample apps.

- Environment: [Royal Esplanade](https://polyhaven.com/a/royal_esplanade).
- Author: Greg Zaal.
- License: [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
- JPEG source: [Three.js example asset](https://threejs.org/examples/textures/equirectangular/royal_esplanade_2k.hdr.jpg).

The fixture retains its own license; the engine's MIT license does not replace it.
